svg.title: Night Parade of A Thousand Demons — The Lantern Procession. Draft 1 / Shadow classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Hour of the Ox forks into Hungry Ghost's Draught then Feast of a Thousand Mouths, or Hide of the Oni then Barred Gate of Yomi. Oni's Heavy Hand forks into Grip of the Yurei then March of a Thousand Demons, or Marked by the Herald then Toll of the Night Bell. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Shadow-classified Night Parade of A Thousand Demons jutsu.

The two Shadow damage rows (Possessing Yurei single target, Oni Hammer Swing radius-1 circle; 45 power, 60 AP, cooldown 7) are the only direct damage and take the raw-power route under root B, which also carries Oni Hammer Swing's 30% Decrease Damage Given rider. Herald of the Black Night's 35% Increase Damage Taken (element-less, all four stat types, friendly fire ENEMIES, radius-1 circle at range 5 for 40 AP) is the kit's pressure tag and the fourth route; it amplifies every non-pierce hit on exposed enemies from any source, the summoned Underworld Gate ally included, so it is held to the Taiyo Kami +7 ceiling. Bell"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":null,"design_notes":["Node split: two roots, four Hidden Arts, four Advanced Arts, every capstone 3 BP deep, two capstones 5 BP under one root or 6 across roots. Root A (Hour of the Ox, +2 IDG and +2 DDT on the Conduit) forks into Lifesteal (3, then 5 with +3 IDG) and Decrease Damage Taken (3, then 5 with +2 Lifesteal). Root B (Oni's Heavy Hand, +1 Damage on both Shadow hits and +2 DDG on the Hammer) forks into Damage (2, then 3) and Increase Damage Taken (3, then 4 with +3 DDG).","Flats by coverage: Damage reaches two 45-power rows, so the route totals +6 (1+2+3; 45\u219251), the two-row guardrail Musashi Ken and Lycanthropy use. Single rows carry the larger flats: Decrease Damage Taken 2+3+5 = +10 (35\u219245%), Lifesteal 3+5 = +8 (40\u219248%, 12 points under the leech cap), Increase Damage Taken 3+4 = +7 (35\u219242%, the Taiyo Kami / Oblivion Seal exposure ceiling; the Herald exposes a whole circle to every source). Decrease Damage Given stays at +5 (30\u219235%); its row is an ally hazard.","Capstone secondaries never out-bid a sibling Hidden Art: Barred Gate of Yomi takes +2 Lifesteal, below Hungry Ghost's Draught's +3; Feast of a Thousand Mouths takes +3 Increase Damage Given, a tag no Hidden Art carries (+5 ceiling with Hour of the Ox); Toll of the Night Bell takes +3 Decrease Damage Given, which only the root carries. March of a Thousand Demons is Damage-only, like Solar Cataclysm. Strongest full build by row weight is 19 on 7 rows (Oblivion Seal 23 on 7, Taiyo Kami 31 on 9).","Interactions: every non-damage supported row is element-less and lists all four stat types, so at the pin the Conduit's buffs, the Herald's exposure and the Hammer's suppression match every non-pierce hit of any stat type (Lifesteal also counts pierce). The bloodline passive (Increase Damage Given 25% + 0.15/level; Earth, None, Shadow, Water, Wind) is not a potency target; it multiplies in its own stage and stacks with the Conduit buff under BATTLE_TAG_STACKING. Damage modifiers skip pierce.","Delivery and uptime: the Conduit is a SELF cast, so its three rows are realized on the caster at cast time (not positional); 40 AP, cooldown 7, 2 rounds, so at most 2 of 7 rounds. Herald of the Black Night (OTHER_USER, AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN radius 1, range 5, 40 AP, cooldown 7) applies its exposure once to each living enemy on the tiles; the caster is never a target. Oni Hammer Swing (OPPONENT, same method, range 4, 60 AP) damages enemies only; its DDG rider (friendly fire none) reaches allies too.","Fourth purchases: Sustain (01, 02, 03) takes Hide of the Oni (40% reduction) or Oni's Heavy Hand (46 power, 32% suppression); Fortress (01, 04, 05) takes Oni's Heavy Hand or Hungry Ghost's Draught (45% lifesteal); Burst (06, 07, 08) takes Hour of the Ox (37% given / taken) or Marked by the Herald (38% exposure); Pressure (06, 09, 10) takes Grip of the Yurei (48 power) or Hour of the Ox. Capstone-less hybrids (e.g. 01, 02, 04, 06 or 01, 06, 07, 09) are enumerated by the validator; see the audit."],"risks":["Classification: Shadow is the single signature element but not exclusive in the census (13 collisions, incl. INCLUDE bloodlines Blood-Enchanted Eyes, Godstorm Eclipse, Oblivion Seal and Shadow Weaver); the tree assumes a bloodline-scoped whole-kit classification, not a bare Shadow match. The current resolver matches only the 2 damage rows; 5 fall back to None. Normal-jutsu Shadow use: unverified.","Ally hazard (accepted, small): Oni Hammer Swing row 1 (Decrease Damage Given 30%) is an INHERIT row on an OPPONENT AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN with friendly fire none, so allies on the radius-1 tiles around the target receive the suppression too; the caster never does. Oni's Heavy Hand (+2) and Toll of the Night Bell (+3) raise it to 35% for allies and enemies alike. Positioning decides; solo it is gain.","Increase Damage Taken reach: the Herald's exposure (element-less, all four stat types) amplifies every non-pierce hit each exposed enemy takes for 2 rounds from any source (allies, weapons, normal jutsu, the Underworld Gate summon), and one cast can expose several enemies, so the Pressure build's row weight (18) understates it. +7 matches Taiyo Kami's Stellar Inferno ceiling; +8 (3+5) is heavier.","Lifesteal budget: the 60%-of-pre-shield-damage leech cap is shared with vamp, so 48% leaves 12 points of headroom and any vamp from equipment or the main tree erodes the capstone's value. healprevent on the caster blocks it entirely; the kit itself applies none. Lifesteal includes pierce hits, which the kit does not have, so only weapons or normal jutsu with pierce feed it that way.","Increase Damage Given stacking: the +5 glue adds statically to the Conduit's 35% self buff, which stacks with the bloodline passive (bloodline-sourced modifiers multiply and honour allowBloodlineDamageIncrease) and any main-tree or gear modifiers; BATTLE_TAG_STACKING is true at the pin. Combined final damage was not simulated.","Realized value: all five jutsu share cooldown 7 and both damage casts cost 60 AP, so the Conduit's 2-round window rarely covers both hits and the Herald's exposure in one rotation; per-row numbers overstate per-round value. Whether a Conduit buff affects a hit cast in the same round, and whether the exposure lands before the hits, was not verified against combat timing. Nothing was simulated.","Damage is formula-calculated (sqrt scaling on Highest / Highest) and then multiplied by the Increase Damage Given passive, the Conduit buff and any exposure, so +6 raw power is not a linear +6 damage; March of a Thousand Demons is the lowest-weight capstone (+3 on two rows). Each Damage row fires at most once per 7 rounds.","Unsupported rows and modes: Possessing Yurei's stun, Herald of the Black Night's buffprevent (itself an ally-hazard row, unchanged by any node) and the Underworld Gate summon receive nothing. Skill-tree and bloodline effects are skipped in ranked PvP and ranked sparring at the pin, so no node applies there."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":10,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":4,"advanced_art_count":4,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":5,"3":10,"4":14},"full_budget_allocations":14,"non_dominated_full_allocations":14,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagegiven":5,"decreasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":7,"decreasedamagetaken":10,"lifesteal":8},"supported_rows_in_kit":7,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"damage":2,"decreasedamagegiven":1,"decreasedamagetaken":1,"increasedamagegiven":1,"increasedamagetaken":1,"lifesteal":1},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["damage","decreasedamagegiven","decreasedamagetaken","increasedamagegiven","increasedamagetaken","lifesteal"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 1 / Shadow classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.","All existing supported tags of Night Parade of A Thousand Demons jutsu inherit Shadow potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.","Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.","Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this g.text: BLOODRIGHT / NIGHT PARADE OF A THOUSAND DEMONS
Draft 1 / Shadow classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Night Parade of A Thousand Demons jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Feast of a Thousand Mouths path + Hide of the Oni
Barred Gate of Yomi path + Oni's Heavy Hand
March of a Thousand Demons path + Hour of the Ox
Toll of the Night Bell path + Grip of the Yurei
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · LS: Lifesteal
FINAL NIGHT PARADE OF A THOUSAND DEMONS TAG VALUES
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
